description: A bare true key in a static map is the string true
notes: The spec makes a bare identifier key a literal name, but in expressions true is the keyword for the bool true, and a keyword's role supersedes other interpretations. A static map doesn't convert keys to strings, so the two readings give the string "true" or the bool true. hashicorp/hcl gives the string: ObjectConsKeyExpr.Value names the key with hcl.ExprAsKeyword, and LiteralValueExpr.AsTraversal turns the true literal back into its name (hclsyntax/expression.go).
